tasks.title: Test the modal global + jQuery shim fix (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Verify: (1) `npx mix` compiles cleanly; (2) the compiled bundle at public/js/app.js contains a bootstrap global assignment (`grep -c 'window.bootstrap=' public/js/app.js` >= 1) and the jQuery shim (`grep -c 'fn.modal' public/js/app.js` >= 1); (3) confirm the four leaveapproval modules are still wired: `grep -c 'new bootstrap.Modal' public/js/app.js` should be >= 4 (the four approve-button handlers) and the moduleLoader context still picks them up (run `npx mix` output shows no errors; optionally `node -e "const ctx=require('webpack');"` is NOT needed - just verify the modules exist on disk and mix compiled them in); (4) `php artisan test` full suite passes (report count; do not fix unrelated failures); (5) sanity-check the shim logic in isolation with node: write a tiny node script that stubs a fake `bootstrap.Modal` with getOrCreateInstance/show/hide and runs the shim's body against a fake element array to prove `$(el).modal('show')` calls `show()` and `$(el).modal('hide')` calls `hide()` - run it and paste the output. Report each step's output and your verdict that the app-wide modal APIs now work.

Document the modal global + shim fix (this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Append a short section 'Modal API Global Fix' to docs/changelog/2026-08-17-leave-approval-api-datatable.md (the existing changelog for today): one paragraph - modals across the app did not open/close via JS: the webpack bundle loads bootstrap 5.3.8 but never assigns window.bootstrap (UMD module.exports branch), and Bootstrap 5 has no jQuery plugin, so `new bootstrap.Modal(el)` (leave-approval approve modals) threw ReferenceError and legacy `$('#x').modal('show'|'hide')` calls (appraisal form/mark/apoint pages) threw TypeError; fix: resources/js/app.js now exposes `window.bootstrap = require('bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle')` and adds a small `$.fn.modal(action)` shim delegating to `bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(el)[action]()` - one-line fix, no per-page changes needed, all 7 affected module files work again. Include the verification results (npx mix, grep counts for the global and shim in the compiled bundle, node shim-logic test, php artisan test count from the tester's report). Do not invent details. Report the file edited and a one-line summary.
